quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's impact on the Knicks' championship aspirations
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is doing the type of stuff that sparks these debates.
quotes.quote: I don't care to be honest with you where Jalen Brunson falls in that debate. I'd like the other debate better. The 6-2 and under thing is wild. Chris Paul deserves to be on that list, but Jalen Brunson is doing the type of stuff that sparks these debates.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's inconsistent performance and rotation challenges
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama has a rollercoaster element to his game.
quotes.quote: As great as Victor Wembanyama is, part of this is his youth and him trying to figure out the chess match. He has a rollercoaster element to his game. They've got to get him inside more. Yes, it was super fun when he hit that 35-footer in the last round in Game 1, but getting pushed out by Keldon Johnson, getting pushed out by OG Anunoby and Mitchell Robinson is a problem.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The potential domino effect of benching De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: The moment you open the door to the Dylan Harper era and you put De'Aaron Fox on the bench, there's going to be a domino effect.
quotes.quote: The moment you open the door to the Dylan Harper era and you put De'Aaron Fox on the bench, there's going to be a domino effect. And that's very tricky for them from a planning standpoint, because yes, they have this historical backdrop where Mike Brown famously agrees to go to the bench with Gregg Popovich's nudging, and the rest is history. Mike Brown was not making 60 million dollars a year, which is what De'Aaron Fox is on track to make.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's potential trade request and team fit concerns
quotes.excerpt: Giannis Antetokounmpo has questions about what that Miami roster would look like on the other side of a deal.
quotes.quote: It appears everybody you talk to says Miami at the deadline had a deal that was close, had a deal that they thought was going to happen, the Bucks ended up backing out. The noise is tied to Miami, but there's also some intel discussion understanding that Giannis Antetokounmpo has questions about what that Miami roster would look like on the other side of a deal. It reminds me of the Carmelo Anthony dilemma when he went from Denver to the Knicks. You don't want to gut the roster, go to the place that you're excited to be in, and then have a hard time contending for a championship. And that is where we'll see what happens in these next few weeks because in one of your backyards, I think the Celtics are a pretty intriguing option where, in terms of being competitive, if you do something with Boston, and this is what we had heard from Giannis's side, that the intrigue is real, the respect for Joe Mazzulla, the way that he might see that roster.

quotes.speaker: Dan Patrick
quotes.summary_phrase: Dan Patrick's skepticism regarding a Giannis to Celtics trade
quotes.excerpt: I still struggle to see why Boston would give up the kind of assets it would need.
quotes.quote: I can see why Giannis would want to play in Boston. I still struggle to see why Boston would give up the kind of assets it would need to give up to go and get Giannis. Not that they aren't considering it, but if I'm running the Celtics, I'm not trading Jaylen Brown and a couple of draft picks for Giannis Antetokounmpo. Mostly because I don't trust Giannis's health. I don't trust that he's had multiple years of soft tissue injuries.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of Jaylen Brown's comments on team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: When the noise got loud a couple months ago regarding Jaylen Brown and how he saw the season.
quotes.quote: It is very sensitive too. Like the Jaylen Brown thing that you just hit on. When the noise got loud a couple months ago regarding Jaylen Brown and how he saw the season and all the chatter about what he said on the livestream that it was the most funny they'd ever had and that was confusing because it just set this message that he wanted his own team.
